title: The Warrior Who Would Not Fight

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE III: DEFENSE, RAIDS AND THE FALLEN (LCC-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
"If anyone comes to raid our homeland, we'll be ready." Isola's people are peaceful but no pushovers: stamping dances and war chants, watch fires and plans, raids fended off or not, prisoners and bargains, and how the village honors those who defended it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A strong villager refuses to train as a warrior: respect it, or ask them to serve in another way.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is the strongest person in the village, and everyone expected (subject.him/her) to train with the warriors. (subject.He/she) has refused. (subject.He/she) says (subject.he/she) will not lift a spear against anyone, ever. (friend), who leads the warriors, is baffled and a little angry. What should (friend) do?

choices.label: Ask for Another Way to Serve

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) lets it go, though (friend.he/she) does not understand. Some people call (subject) a coward behind (subject.his/her) back. (subject) hears it and says nothing. When the next storm comes, (subject) carries more people out of a flooded hut than anyone, and the whispers stop.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) asks (subject) if (subject.he/she) would carry the wounded instead, if it ever comes to that. (subject) agrees at once, and learns everything the healers can teach about binding wounds and carrying people safely. The warriors start calling (subject.him/her) the Shield-Without-a-Spear. (subject) likes that.
